abstract:
BACKGROUND: SharkCore fine-needle biopsy (FNB) provides ample intact tissue for rapid on-site evaluation and ancillary studies. Diagnosing well-differentiated pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains challenging, particularly in the absence of stromal invasion. The diagnostic significance of edge involvement (EI), defined as ductal epithelial cells at the edge of stromal fragments, in SharkCore FNB specimens of PDAC, was evaluated.
DESIGN: A total of 42 PDAC FNBs were reviewed over a 1-year period. Smears and corresponding histology specimens were evaluated for the presence of EI, stromal invasion, and detached background tumor cells. Histology specimens were classified as low-grade (well/moderately differentiated) or high-grade (poorly differentiated). A benign cohort of 27 pancreatic FNBs was included.
RESULTS: On smears, EI was identified in 39/42 (92.9%), stromal invasion in 22/42 (52.4%), and detached background tumor cells in 41/42 (97.6%) cases. On histology, EI was present in 38/42 (90.5%), stromal invasion in 32/42 (76.2%), and background tumor cells in 37/42 (88.1%) cases. One case showing EI was initially interpreted as benign but was found to be a low-grade PDAC on repeat FNB. On histology, EI without stromal invasion was observed in 7/26 low-grade tumors, whereas stromal invasion with EI was present in 15/16 high-grade tumors. In the benign cohort, EI was absent on histology but identified in 2/27 smears (7.4%), both lacking follow-ups. EI was significantly more frequent in PDAC, with sensitivity/specificity of 92.9%/92.6% in smears and 90.5%/100.0% in histology.
CONCLUSION: EI is a specific diagnostic clue for PDAC that improves diagnostic confidence, particularly in low-grade tumors.
key_points_ko: 도말 검사에서 기질 가장자리 침범(EI)은 PDAC 환자의 92.9%(39/42)에서 확인되었습니다.
조직학적 검사에서 기질 가장자리 침범(EI)은 PDAC 환자의 90.5%(38/42)에서 관찰되었습니다.
기질 가장자리 침범(EI)은 PDAC 진단에 대해 도말에서 민감도 92.9%와 특이도 92.6%, 조직학에서 민감도 90.5%와 특이도 100.0%를 나타냈습니다.
양성 대조군(27례)에서는 조직학적으로 기질 가장자리 침범(EI)이 관찰되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 SharkCore 세침생검(FNB)을 이용한 췌관선암종(PDAC) 진단에서 기질 가장자리 침범(EI)의 진단적 의의를 평가했습니다. 총 42례의 PDAC와 27례의 양성 대조군을 대상으로 도말 표본과 조직학적 표본을 검토했습니다. 연구 결과, 가장자리 침범(EI)은 PDAC 진단에서 도말 기준 민감도 92.9%와 특이도 92.6%, 조직학 기준 민감도 90.5%와 특이도 100.0%를 보였습니다. 결론적으로 기질 가장자리 침범(EI)은 췌관선암종(PDAC)에 대한 특이적인 진단 단서이며, 특히 저등급 종양의 진단 신뢰도를 향상시킵니다.
title: Stromal edge involvement in FNB of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: An important diagnostic clue
title_ko: 췌관선암종의 세침생검에서 기질 가장자리 침범: 중요한 진단적 단서
